verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit docs directly confirm auto-review controls: disable/re-enable via keyword or label, restrict to certain branches, skip draft PRs, and pause after a set number of commits (coderabbit-docs-21), plus on-demand triggers like @coderabbitai review/full review commands (coderabbit-docs-15) and CLI/agent-triggered reviews (coderabbit-docs-2, coderabbit-docs-17). This covers drafts, branch/label filtering, and on-demand triggering as described in the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation that these specific controls (draft-skip, label-based re-enable) work as documented in practice.
